gen-gf-gabarito-gf-m-plus-2: Gabarito draws every stroke with one nib, its terminals cut open so the counters spill outward. M PLUS 2 follows with a gaping c and a friendly sans build, where the heading shows off and the body gets on with the reading.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-m-plus-code-latin: Gabarito leads with expressive, open-cut terminals, while M PLUS Code Latin sits below like bent neon tubing with a wide-mouthed c. Paragraphs flow along smoothly in it.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: Gabarito has a distinctive, nib-drawn look, its terminals sliced open so the counters flow outward. And M PLUS Rounded 1c, a plain sans, stops its terminals short of curling back, which leaves the display lines the only ones making a fuss.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-mandali: Mandali reads in a friendly, clean way, giving each e a generous entry into its eye. Gabarito is the showpiece, skimming along on strokes that never change weight, while the sans body simply gets on with the text.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-manjari: Gabarito is the expressive one, with a single nib's look and terminals cut open for outward-flowing counters. Manjari, a plain sans, does the quieter job, its curves ending in wide, unclosed terminals and a steady line weight.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-meera-inimai: Approachable curves with room to breathe define Meera Inimai, which has a blueprint-lettering feel of constant line beneath the expressive Gabarito. Open terminals link them.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-metrophobic: Metrophobic sends your eye around each bend along a smooth, unobstructed path, a modern, clean sans. Metrophobic's clarity meets Gabarito, whose single unbroken line weight runs from terminals to junctions.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-mina: Contemporary and plain-spoken, Mina draws strokes like stitched thread outlines. Its generously unclosed round letters keep a longer passage moving easily, while Gabarito's expressive nib-drawn heading adds the character.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-mingzat: Mingzat reads with curvy, unclamped letters. Over a longer stretch, this plain sans stays contemporary and loose, a relaxed foil to Gabarito's constant-width outline you can follow with a finger.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-moderustic: Moderustic reads modern, its curves traced with a broad nib and left unfinished. And a longer passage in this plain sans feels loose and open, while Gabarito's r, n and m keep arches matching their stems.
